correctness.rationale: Finite graph constructed exactly from the Fano incidence difference set; all BFS distances cross-checked with Floyd-Warshall; odd-scale facet identity from edge-midpoint witnesses. Complete oriented Hasse graphs acyclic for faulted (338 pairs, 37 degree-2 critical cells), intact (399 pairs, 48) and relative (61 pairs, 11); the relative matching also acyclic in full face poset with the faulted faces held fixed. The base is simply connected, so the eleven relative 2-cell attachments are null and the second-homology inclusion is primitive. A separate exact binary chain reduction corroborates face vectors and Betti numbers.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical cubic girth-six graph and the first post-girth graph Čech threshold has 48 integral sphere classes. An edge fault recomputed in the graph metric causes exactly eleven primitive sphere losses with no torsion or newly born lower classes, demonstrated by a relative homotopy splitting rather than a routine Euler-rank count. The exact induced map is relevant to robustness and persistent topological comparisons of graph metric nerves.
